title: WhatsApp
description: Link your organization's own number with a QR code; customer notifications go out from it when a notification rule lists the WhatsApp channel.
forbidden: You are not allowed to manage WhatsApp (integration management is required).
session.title: Session
session.not_connected_help: WhatsApp is not connected yet. Once linked, reservation and rental notices reach customers on WhatsApp; without a connection the rule moves on to its next channel (e.g. SMS).
session.dropped_description: Notifications go out on the fallback channels for now. The system retries the connection every few minutes; if the phone logged out, reconnect and scan the QR code.
connect.title: Connect WhatsApp
connect.description: After connecting you are asked to scan the QR code with your phone.
connect.submit: Connect and show the QR code
connect.provider_help: Production uses wuzapi; the test provider sends nothing.
connect.acknowledge: I have read and accept the number risk.
connect.unavailable: The WhatsApp gateway is not configured on this server. Contact your system administrator.
risk.title: Number risk
risk.unofficial: The connection runs as a WhatsApp Web session; it is not WhatsApp's official business API.
risk.ban: Bulk, unsolicited or reported messages can get your number restricted or banned by WhatsApp.
risk.transactional: Only transactional notices (reservation, rental, payment reminders) are sent; marketing needs separate consent and never goes out on this channel.
risk.number: We recommend a separate business number; the linked phone must stay online.
qr.title: Scan the QR code with your phone
qr.step_devices: Tap Settings → Linked devices → Link a device.
qr.step_scan: Scan the code on this screen; the connection shows up within seconds.
qr.failed: Could not load the QR code
settings.title: Send settings
settings.rate_limit_help: Between {{min}} and {{max}}. One number gets at most 10 messages an hour; above the limit the notification moves to the fallback channel.
settings.transactional_only: WhatsApp is used for transactional notices only. A message without a delivery receipt within 60 minutes counts as failed and the rule moves on to its next channel.
test.title: Send a test message
test.description: A fixed test text goes out from the linked number and is logged.
test.phone_help: Turkish numbers may be written as 0532… or +90532….
confirm.logout_description: The phone is unlinked; notifications go out on the fallback channels. Reconnecting needs a new QR scan.
confirm.remove_description: The session is deleted and the WhatsApp integration is disabled. The message log is kept.
messages.title: Message log
errors.session: Could not load the WhatsApp state.
errors.qr: Could not load the QR code; refresh the state.
errors.test: Could not send the test message.
errors.messages: Could not load the message log.
